concept.reason: Actual specimen skeleton, original skull multiple views and official specimen/interpretive page already available.

scope: Complete deep-bodied short-legged diprotodontid marsupial with conspicuously broad projecting cheek region. Not an isolated skull, actual rhinoceros or tapir.

scale.measurement_basis: Owen1859 p169 quotes Macleay original adult Sydney skull: approximately18in extreme length and15in widest zygoma. Historical approximate specimen dimensions, not direct measurement of P17002.
scale.whole_body_status: Conservative illustrative living-body dimensions fitted to specimen skeletal proportions, NOT measured complete body. Official Naracoorte estimate300–500kg is contextual, not a geometry measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Short broad deep head, exceptionally expanded lateral cheek regions and modest descending cheek mass. Visible in front and top silhouettes, not just painted patches.
Large barrel torso and four relatively short robust weight-bearing limbs; deep chest and clear belly-to-ground gap. Retain fore/hind articulation from museum skeleton, no sausage with peg legs.
Short broad muzzle with modest enlarged paired incisors, no canines, long tusks, rhino horn, trunk or tapir proboscis.
Short plain tail and small rounded ears are conservative soft-tissue reconstructions; avoid kangaroo tail and hopping stance.
Neutral muted brown-gray coat; no fossil certainty for color, texture, ear size or external nasal soft tissue.
This is alive soft tissue over anatomy; do not copy exposed skeletal holes, metal mount bars or museum plinth.
uncertainties: Skin, coat, ears, tail and external soft-tissue contours inferred, not preserved.
Mounted P17002 is incomplete, feet poorly visible and mount posture reconstructed. Do not treat every mount detail as fossil certainty.
1859 paper contains obsolete synonymy and speculative horn/trunk assertions; use its actual cranium geometry/measurements only, not those conjectures.
Historical plate fig5 is KOALA comparison, never use it as target nose.
acceptance: Cheek width and deep short-legged body clear in exactGLB front/side/top/perspective.
No rhino horn, proboscis, kangaroo limb plan or skeletal holes in living reconstruction.
Original self-contained generator, declared dependencies, numeric budgets, two reproducible builds and independent QA.
